title: Paying from a goal's money, a goal account that goes overdrawn, a skipped bill, a top-up before the e-wallet was set up (review v3 situations 10 to 13)
story: A bank (300,000), a savings account kept for a rainy day (50,000, not for spending) and an e-wallet set up later. Pay of 250,000 on the 10th, moved earlier; rent of 80,000 on the 27th, moved later; a 5,000 top-up from the bank to the e-wallet on the 1st. A trip goal of 100,000 is kept in the bank. On 22 Nov a 60,000 vet bill is paid from the rainy day money, so savings go 10,000 overdrawn. On 24 Nov 3,000 is topped up to the e-wallet, which is set up on 25 Nov with 1,000 (the top-up is inside that figure). On 25 Nov the trip is paid from the trip money. The landlord waives December's rent. Situations 10 and 11 were found sound by the review; situations 12 and 13 need paying from a place (H7). Every amount is made up.
